scenes.headline: How AI short-drama tools keep a face the same
scenes.sub: Six open-source generators, read at the source
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Matinee! Today: how AI short-drama tools keep one character looking like one person.

scenes.text: Draw each character once as a multi-view reference sheet, then send that sheet with every single video call.
scenes.say: Draw each character once, as a reference sheet. Then send it with every call to the video model.

steps.say: A language model writes the script and lists the characters. Each gets a sheet: face, front, side and back.
The script is cut into segments of eight to fifteen seconds.
Each segment goes to the video model with the sheets of whoever is in it.
Here is a character node on Toonflow's canvas.
One board: a close-up, then front, side and back, on plain white.

scenes.title: Two ways to carry a face forward

left.title: Chain the last frame
items: Each clip starts from the previous end
left.say: The tempting shortcut is starting each clip from the last frame before it. The face drifts every hop.

right.title: Re-send the sheet
items: Every segment lists its own references
Every call returns to the same anchor
right.say: What works: every segment re-sends its own sheets, so every call returns to the same anchor.

steps.say: The research system ViMax adds a camera graph: the wide first shot anchors the shots after it.
And a vision model picks the better of two keyframes.

scenes.title: What a kept minute costs

parts.say: p is the price per generated second.
r is the retake rate: seconds generated per second kept.

scenes.say: Video is nearly the whole bill. So a kept minute is sixty, times r, times p.

scenes.title: List price per second at 720p
scenes.say: At list price, Seedance two point oh is just under a yuan a second.

scenes.label: for one kept minute at 720p, with no retakes
scenes.say: So a kept minute with no retakes is about fifty-nine yuan. Every retake pays for the whole segment again.

scenes.text: The video model holds the face. The pipeline does the bookkeeping, and the retake rate sets the bill.
scenes.mark: the retake rate sets the bill
scenes.say: The video model holds the face. The pipeline keeps the books. The retake rate sets the bill.
One sheet per character, sent on every call, and a bill set by retakes.
